_comment: Every string the candidate reads on the ranked-offers page.
`en` is the source: it is the text that was written first and the text a
reviewer argues about. Every other language records `of` — the sha256 of the
English it was translated from — so changing the English makes each
translation *provably* stale rather than quietly wrong. That is the whole
mechanism: `strings.stale()` compares the recorded sha against the current
source and the gate fails on any mismatch. Nobody has to remember.
One file rather than one per language, on purpose: a wording change and the
translations it invalidates then appear in the same diff hunk, which is what
makes the rule reviewable instead of merely stated.
A language this repo does not maintain arrives as a pack — same entry shape,
its own file — and is checked for completeness and staleness by the same
gate. It is never checked for quality: no machine can tell whether the German
is good German, so a pack carries who translated it and when, and says so.

provisional_label.note: Said once per page when the ranking is L1, never when it is not.
provisional_label.en: Provisional: I have put these in an order — the ranking — using only the things you said are non-negotiable and the pay, because I do not yet know how much each thing is worth to you. Working through step 6's paired choices is what would sharpen it.

es.text: Provisional: he puesto estas ofertas en un orden — el ranking — usando solo lo que dijiste que es innegociable y el sueldo, porque todavía no sé cuánto vale cada cosa para ti. Trabajar las elecciones por parejas del paso 6 es lo que lo afinaría.

ca.text: Provisional: he posat aquestes ofertes en un ordre — el rànquing — fent servir només allò que vas dir que és innegociable i el sou, perquè encara no sé quant val cada cosa per a tu. Treballar les eleccions per parelles del pas 6 és el que ho afinaria.

excluded_explanation.note: Follows the heading and its count on the same line.
excluded_explanation.en: — you cannot apply for these, and this is the wording each was removed for:

es.text: — no puedes optar a estas, y esta es la frase por la que se descartó cada una:

ca.text: — no pots optar a aquestes, i aquesta és la frase per la qual es va descartar cadascuna:

no_reason_given.note: An exclusion that arrived with no wording behind it. Never omitted.
no_reason_given.en: (no reason was recorded — this is a defect, please report it)

es.text: (no se registró ningún motivo — esto es un fallo, por favor comunícalo)

ca.text: (no s'ha registrat cap motiu — això és una errada, si us plau comunica-ho)

estimate_basis.en: from the range this role and level pays on comparable adverts

es.text: según el rango que este puesto y nivel pagan en anuncios comparables

ca.text: segons el rang que aquest lloc i nivell paguen en anuncis comparables

stated_marker.note: T243: a card figure the candidate stated rather than chose; precedes the amount.

nothing_priced.note: No drivers: nothing priced moved this offer, and saying so is a sentence.
nothing_priced.en: Nothing the advert says has been priced yet, so there is no reason to give.

es.text: Todavía no se ha valorado nada de lo que dice el anuncio, así que no hay ningún motivo que dar.

ca.text: Encara no s'ha valorat res del que diu l'anunci, així que no hi ha cap motiu a donar.

wording_not_kept.en: the advert's wording was not kept

es.text: no se conservó la frase del anuncio

ca.text: no s'ha conservat la frase de l'anunci

salary_range_join.note: Joins the two ends of a pay band. Spaces are significant.

term_ranking.note: INTERNAL_TERMS. The plain words that must appear before the jargon does.
term_ranking.en: I have put these in an order

es.text: he puesto estas ofertas en un orden

ca.text: he posat aquestes ofertes en un ordre

term_weights.en: how much each thing is worth to you

es.text: cuánto vale cada cosa para ti

ca.text: quant val cada cosa per a tu

term_part_worth.en: what one step of a trade-off is worth in money

es.text: lo que vale en dinero un paso de un intercambio

ca.text: el que val en diners un pas d'un intercanvi

term_connector.en: the piece that reads one job board

es.text: la pieza que lee un portal de empleo

ca.text: la peça que llegeix un portal de feina

more_groups.note: Interpolates {remaining} and {further}. Not 'not shown' — the rest exists and is one word away.
more_groups.en: ({remaining} more, in {further} further group(s) — say the word and I'll show the next.)

es.text: ({remaining} más, en {further} grupo(s) más — dímelo y te enseño el siguiente.)

ca.text: ({remaining} més, en {further} grup(s) més — digue-m'ho i t'ensenyo el següent.)

stack_not_assessed.en: Not assessed: no stack fit was computed for this offer.

es.text: Sin evaluar: no se calculó el ajuste de tecnologías para esta oferta.

ca.text: Sense avaluar: no s'ha calculat l'ajust de tecnologies per a aquesta oferta.

es.text: usada en tu experiencia, sin nivel

ca.text: usada en la teva experiència, sense nivell

stack_averse.en: you said you would rather not

ca.text: vas dir que no la vols

es.text: Lo que juega a tu favor: {items}.

ca.text: El que juga a favor teu: {items}.

standing_no_strengths.en: None of the technologies the shown adverts name is one your CV or your words put at working level.

es.text: Ninguna de las tecnologías que nombran los anuncios mostrados consta en tu CV o en lo que dijiste como nivel de trabajo.

ca.text: Cap de les tecnologies que anomenen els anuncis mostrats consta al teu CV o a allò que vas dir com a nivell de treball.

standing_no_widen.en: Nothing the shown adverts name is missing from your stack or held at a low level.

es.text: Nada de lo que nombran los anuncios mostrados falta en tu stack o está a nivel bajo.

ca.text: Res del que anomenen els anuncis mostrats falta al teu stack o és a nivell baix.

standing_unknown.en: The shown adverts name no technology, so there is nothing to say about your stack from them.

es.text: Los anuncios mostrados no nombran tecnologías, así que no hay nada que decir de tu stack a partir de ellos.

ca.text: Els anuncis mostrats no anomenen tecnologies, així que no hi ha res a dir del teu stack a partir d'ells.

standing_ask.en: Is any of that of interest to you?
